title: CodeGuard AI: Architecture-Agnostic Security & Code Quality Agent
short_description: An AI agent that scans any codebase (any language or stack) for security vulnerabilities, AI-generated slop, coding gaps and loose ends, and reports each issue with file, line, severity, explanation and a suggested fix.
